description: Helper functions for testing bitmap performance in git, including functions for testing full, partial, and pack bitmaps, as well as creating specific test scenarios.

methods.name: test_full_bitmap
methods.description: Runs a series of performance tests for full bitmap indices using various git commands.

methods.name: test_partial_bitmap
methods.description: Runs performance tests for partial bitmap indices with filtered git commands.

methods.name: test_pack_bitmap
methods.description: Performs various pack bitmap operations and sets up repo states for testing.
